newsitem.title: BERMUDA: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND TAKE SHIELD WITH CONVINCING WIN.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND TAKE SHIELD WITH CONVINCING WIN.

text.p: the Ranfurly Shield they lost six weeks ago by beating Waikato
The first division champions eased hom by four tries to one
and face one defence to retain the trophy over the close season
-- against neighbours North Harbour next weekend.
Waikato made a marvellous start when halfback Simon Crabb
scored to cap a superb move after Auckland had charged down a
Matthew Cooper converted but Auckland lock Richard Fromont
plunged over beside the Waikato posts five minutes later. Adrian
Auckland eased ahead early in the second half when Cashmore
kicked a penalty, then flanker Michael Jones gave them a
decisive advantage when he dived over.
Lee Stensness put the outcome beyond doubt when he scored
the first of his two tries in the 57th minute.
